sourceAndTargetAnatomy.source: Four verified isolated donor thumb section centers, preserving their measured relative arc stations
sourceAndTargetAnatomy.target: Actual DEF-thumb.02.R MCP head, DEF-thumb.03.R IP head and actual body skin tip plus 2 mm
sourceAndTargetAnatomy.metacarpal: DEF-thumb.01.R remains an original deformation field; it is excluded from isolated donor digit controls
sourceAndTargetAnatomy.surfaceDomain: MCP signed plane and nearest downstream anatomical digit arc distinguish palm/thenar source 0 from thumb source 5; other digit surface identities remain preserved
sourceAndTargetAnatomy.transition: The MCP-to-second donor section target arc uses source pools 0+5; subsequent thumb surface uses source 5 exclusively
sourceAndTargetAnatomy.preservation: All original body coordinates, named75 rest transforms and deformation influences remain untouched

unchangedGuards.unsupportedExterior: Reject before bake; no offset-body fallback
unchangedGuards.orientation: Every reconstructed hand triangle must retain orientation
unchangedGuards.cavity: Coherent hand patch, true inward shell and cuff rim; closed Euler2 cloth volume

witnessesBeforeGuards: Original source controls and actual MCP/IP/skin-tip control targets
Every target point MCP distance, nearest digit arc distances, permitted source region and unchanged thumb deformation mass
All 36 source/skin section radii, radial scales and fallback sample counts before volume rejection
Every supported source triangle/corner barycentric and semantic region, plus every unsupported point before correspondence rejection
All reversed or degenerate retopology faces before orientation rejection
bake: One original-PBR 4096 dedicated atlas bake under guarded Blender CPU job only after geometry gates pass
limits: Source section centers are geometric hypotheses rather than annotated donor joints
Compact16000-triangle normal bake does not preserve all dense donor microgeometry
Global selected-to-active bake may query a neighboring finger; per-pixel semantic correspondence remains unqualified until validated
Native structural witnesses do not qualify played glove deformation, grip surface or visual quality
execution: Not executed; parent source review and checkpoint precede one corrected intended-final attempt
